notes.title: Our new game - Estiman - now on Greenlight
notes.content:
Stop clocking for a few second - we've got something new! Once again we're turning something so omnipresent and intuitive you'd never even stop to give it thought into an engaging and original game concept. Our upcoming title - [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=783105620]Estiman[/url] - is an arcade visual puzzle game of reflexes and wits that engages the player in its mesmerizing flow one exciting combo after another.

[b]The game is almost ready for distribution, and we need YOUR VOTE on our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=783105620]Steam Greenlight page[/url], so we can bring it to you in November at our favorite $1 / 1€ price point.[/b]

Estiman is: 
[list]
[*]A unique, endless game of reflexes and wits with original estimation-based gameplay 
[*]A dopamine booster with satisfying combos a skilled player can keep going forever 
[*]A minimal audio-visual experience that evolves as you play 
[*]A fantastic selection of game-altering modes and settings 
[*]A limitless gameplay that pleasantly flows and keeps you hooked
[/list]
Drop by the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=783105620]Estiman Greenlight profile[/url], and tell us what what you think!

notes.title: Update! Fixes! Sausages!
notes.content:
Thanks to user DejaVu, we fixed achievements on mode with 5 chances. Also menu is more responsive to give you a better feeling.

Steam trading cards are on the way, so stay focused and keep clocking!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25717702/ef92434a743048b1c4cc99d5010a135ff68ffda7.png[/img]
P.S. Don't put sausages into microwave for too long...
